_comment: CR7 (framework 12.11g): the ONE shared sign-in front SecurityInsight's web app runs behind, pinned by version. state 'contract' = built against the component's contract, the component is not on main yet: a release carries no front and the switch SI_Web_SigninFront cannot be turned on (setup refuses). state 'pinned' = commit names the main commit of FRAMEWORK/signin-front at that version: setup\Publish-SIRelease.ps1 packs exactly that tree into the release (pro-management/signin-front/), and setup / the updater build the front's image from it in the install's own registry. The settings below follow the component's README; a change the component needs for SecurityInsight goes to the coordinator, never into a copy here.
